verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a built-in AI assistant, AskFred, that answers natural-language questions across meetings, keeps follow-up context and can pull out things like action items. Users can also hand meeting recording, transcription and summarization to the Fred bot by inviting it or letting it auto-join. However, the evidence shows AskFred mainly as Q&A. The action-taking tools (share meeting, move meeting, create soundbite) are documented only for external AI clients through the MCP server, not for the in-product assistant. missing for 10: evidence that the built-in assistant can carry out delegated actions or multi-step tasks inside the product, independent or hands-on corroboration.
